items.summary: MCP access pattern for PubMed, OpenAlex, Crossref, Semantic Scholar, and literature evidence workflows, with provenance-first search and guarded API calls.

data_and_services.name: PubMed, through NCBI E-utilities
data_and_services.terms: NLM does not claim the copyright on the abstracts in PubMed, though journal publishers or authors may, and NCBI places no restrictions on the molecular data it holds, though submitters may claim rights in theirs; scripts are to send E-utilities requests to eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov, make no more than 3 requests a second, pass the tool and email parameters, run any series of more than 100 requests at weekends or between 9 pm and 5 am Eastern Time on weekdays, and make NCBI's disclaimer and copyright notice evident to their users (NCBI policies page, https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/home/about/policies/, read 2026-11-27)
data_and_services.credit: National Center for Biotechnology Information, US National Library of Medicine

data_and_services.name: OpenAlex API
data_and_services.terms: OpenAlex data is under CC0, in the public domain (attribution appreciated, not required); free API use is capped at 100,000 credits a day and 100 requests a second, more on a paid plan (OpenAlex's documentation source, ourresearch/openalex-docs license.md and how-to-use-the-api/rate-limits-and-authentication.md at 8cec9db, read 2026-11-27)

data_and_services.name: Crossref REST API
data_and_services.terms: No sign-up is needed, almost none of the metadata is subject to copyright and it may be used for any purpose, though some abstracts may be under their publishers' or authors' copyright; the polite pool asks for a mailto address (Crossref REST API page, https://www.crossref.org/documentation/retrieve-metadata/rest-api/, read 2026-11-27)

data_and_services.name: Semantic Scholar Graph API v1
data_and_services.terms: The Allen Institute for Artificial Intelligence (AI2) grants a limited, non-exclusive, terminable licence to use the API to reach and display the data Semantic Scholar serves, which stay under the licences that come with them (such as CC BY-NC or ODC-BY) and, for third-party content, its owners' terms; users may not redistribute or sublicense the API or exceed or get around its rate limits, are to credit Semantic Scholar in material that draws on it, and are to cite The Semantic Scholar Open Data Platform in scientific publications whose results used it (Semantic Scholar API License Agreement, last updated May 17, 2023, https://www.semanticscholar.org/product/api/license, read 2026-11-28)

data_and_services.name: bioRxiv and medRxiv API (api.biorxiv.org)
data_and_services.terms: The API page states no terms of service; every record it returns carries its preprint's own licence, which governs reuse of that preprint (https://api.biorxiv.org/, read 2026-11-27)

data_and_services.name: Unpaywall API v2
data_and_services.terms: Not read: unpaywall.org's pages render only in a browser, and the API root (https://api.unpaywall.org/v2) names only its documentation page, whose terms were not read (checked 2026-11-27)

items.summary: MCP router for provenance-first public database lookups across biomedical, chemistry, materials, literature, regulatory, patent, and scientific data APIs.

data_and_services.name: NCBI E-utilities (Gene, Protein, Nucleotide, ClinVar, dbSNP, PubMed)
data_and_services.terms: NLM does not claim the copyright on the abstracts in PubMed, though journal publishers or authors may, and NCBI places no restrictions on the molecular data it holds, though submitters may claim rights in theirs; scripts are to send E-utilities requests to eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov, make no more than 3 requests a second, pass the tool and email parameters, run any series of more than 100 requests at weekends or between 9 pm and 5 am Eastern Time on weekdays, and make NCBI's disclaimer and copyright notice evident to their users (NCBI policies page, https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/home/about/policies/, read 2026-11-27)
data_and_services.credit: National Center for Biotechnology Information, US National Library of Medicine
data_and_services.how: read at run time through publicdb_get (GET), a target of the adapter.json at v0.2.0 (7614afd)

data_and_services.name: NCBI BLAST URL API
data_and_services.terms: BLAST is public domain software, and NCBI places no restrictions on the molecular data it holds, though submitters may claim rights in theirs; the shared BLAST servers ask API users to call at most once every 10 seconds, poll one search at most once a minute, send the email and tool parameters, and run more than 50 searches at night or at weekends (BLAST developer page, https://blast.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/doc/blast-help/developerinfo.html, and the NCBI policies page, https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/home/about/policies/, read 2026-11-27)
data_and_services.credit: National Center for Biotechnology Information, US National Library of Medicine
data_and_services.how: read at run time through publicdb_get (GET), a target of the adapter.json at v0.2.0 (7614afd)

data_and_services.name: UniProt REST API
data_and_services.terms: CC BY 4.0; terms: https://www.uniprot.org/help/license (as BioMCP 0.9.3's source inventory records it, reviewed 2026-09-27)
data_and_services.how: read at run time through publicdb_get (GET), a target of the adapter.json at v0.2.0 (7614afd)

data_and_services.name: Ensembl REST API
data_and_services.terms: Ensembl imposes no restrictions on access to or use of its data and software; some included data and software may carry third-party constraints, which users must establish and follow (Ensembl disclaimer, https://www.ensembl.org/info/about/legal/disclaimer.html, read 2026-11-27)
data_and_services.how: read at run time through publicdb_get (GET, and POST on the routes it declares as reads), a target of the adapter.json at v0.2.0 (7614afd)

data_and_services.name: ClinPGx (formerly PharmGKB)
data_and_services.terms: PharmGKB's own domain now redirects to ClinPGx and the former terms pages are gone; the successor data-usage policy (read from the live page's JS bundle) states ClinPGx data is CC BY-SA 4.0. Verified 2026-09-28 against the same page CPIC was, since both routes lead to one policy; terms: https://www.clinpgx.org/page/dataUsagePolicy (as BioMCP 0.9.3's source inventory records it, reviewed 2026-09-28)
data_and_services.how: read at run time through publicdb_get (GET), a target of the adapter.json at v0.2.0 (7614afd)
